'SharedCostInduction.accumulated_cost' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'SharedCostInduction.uniform_increment_bound' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'SharedCostInduction.bounded_increment_bound' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'SharedCostInduction.polynomial_two_term_bound' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'SharedCostInduction.polynomial_monomial_bound' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
'SharedCostInduction.polynomial_family_bound' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
scope: Finite induction and polynomial consequences of supplied shared scalar increment bounds.
state_semantics: S(i) counts the same accumulated circuit; increments count only newly added scalar gates.

bounds.family_constants: K0,A,K,a,b,c are quantified before n and are independent of n

hypotheses: For each i<m: S(i+1) <= S(i) + increment(i)
n >= 1 for the single-monomial and family bounds
Every increment concerns new scalar gates on compatible interfaces of the same shared circuit
